Requirement_Description: CanIf_Init shall initialize all CanIf-internal variables and set module state to initialized
Notes: Sets initRun=TRUE; initializes channelData array

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Init shall set all CAN controller modes to CANIF_CS_STOPPED
Notes: Loop sets each channel ControllerMode = CANIF_CS_STOPPED

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Init shall set all PDU channel modes to CANIF_GET_OFFLINE
Notes: Loop sets each channel PduMode = CANIF_GET_OFFLINE

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall have access to CAN Driver configuration data (CanControllerConfigType)
Notes: canConfig pointer obtained from ControllerConfig[]; access to Can_ControllerConfigType

Requirement_Description: If controller is in STARTED state during CanIf_InitController it shall be set to STOPPED first
Notes: Calls CanIf_SetControllerMode(CANIF_CS_STOPPED) if mode==STARTED; DET if not STOPPED

Requirement_Description: CanIf_InitController shall subsequently call the CAN Driver initialization services
Notes: Calls Can_InitController(canControllerId canConfig) then sets mode to STOPPED

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetControllerMode shall transition controller to CANIF_CS_STARTED and enable PDU mode ONLINE
Notes: Calls CanIf_SetPduMode(CANIF_SET_ONLINE) then Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_T_START)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetControllerMode shall transition controller to CANIF_CS_SLEEP via STOPPED state
Notes: If from STARTED: calls CAN_T_STOP first then CAN_T_SLEEP (Figure 33)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetControllerMode shall transition controller to CANIF_CS_STOPPED and set PDU mode OFFLINE
Notes: Calls CanIf_SetPduMode(CANIF_SET_OFFLINE) then Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_T_STOP)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_GetControllerMode shall return the current CAN controller mode via output pointer
Notes: Reads from CanIf_Global.channelData[channel].ControllerMode

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Transmit shall request transmission of a CAN L-PDU to the CAN Driver
Notes: Validates mode then calls Can_Write()

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Transmit shall call Can_Write with the HTH and PDU data
Notes: Can_Write called with CanIfHthIdSymRef and constructed Can_PduType

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Transmit shall check that the CAN controller is in STARTED state before transmitting; if CAN_BUSY is returned tx buffering is not applied
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK if csMode != CANIF_CS_STARTED (L450); returns E_NOT_OK on CAN_BUSY (L475) - buffering not supported

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Transmit shall handle CAN_BUSY return from Can_Write (transmit buffer full)
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK on CAN_BUSY; comment notes buffering not supported

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetPduMode shall set the channel PDU mode according to the requested mode transition
Notes: Full state machine for all 7 set-mode values; transitions stored in channelData[channel].PduMode

Requirement_Description: CanIf_GetPduMode shall return the current channel PDU mode via output pointer
Notes: Reads CanIf_Global.channelData[channel].PduMode

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetDynamicTxId shall update the CAN ID of a dynamic L-PDU
Notes: Updates txEntry->CanIfCanTxPduIdCanId at runtime

Requirement_Description: CanIf_TxConfirmation shall notify upper layer of successful L-PDU transmission
Notes: Calls entry->CanIfUserTxConfirmation() if mode allows TX

Requirement_Description: Upper layer TX confirmation callbacks shall only be called when the PDU channel mode allows transmission
Notes: Checks mode is TX_ONLINE / ONLINE / OFFLINE_ACTIVE before calling upper layer callback (CANIF053 tag at L757)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_RxIndication shall distribute received L-PDU to the configured upper layer module
Notes: Routes to PduR / CanNm / CanTp / J1939Tp based on CanIfRxUserType

Requirement_Description: CanIf_RxIndication shall check the PDU channel mode and discard frame if receiver path is disabled
Notes: Drops frame if mode is OFFLINE / TX_ONLINE / OFFLINE_ACTIVE

Requirement_Description: CanIf_RxIndication shall perform software filtering for BASIC CAN HRH using mask/ID filter
Notes: Supports CANIF_SOFTFILTER_TYPE_MASK; reports DET for unsupported filter types

Requirement_Description: CanIf_RxIndication shall check the DLC of a received L-PDU if DLC check is enabled
Notes: Guarded by #if CANIF_DLC_CHECK==STD_ON; reports DET if CanDlc < configured DLC

Requirement_Description: CanIf_ControllerBusOff shall set the CAN controller mode to STOPPED and notify upper layer
Notes: Calls CanIf_SetControllerMode(CANIF_CS_STOPPED); calls CanIfBusOffNotification dispatch callback

Requirement_Description: CanIf_SetWakeupEvent shall propagate a wakeup event to the EcuM
Notes: Calls CanIfWakeUpNotification if configured in DispatchConfig

Requirement_Description: CanIf_CancelTxConfirmation shall confirm cancellation of a pending Tx PDU
Notes: Guarded by CANIF_TRANSMIT_CANCELLATION==STD_ON; returns E_NOT_OK immediately (not implemented)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_ReadRxPduData shall copy the received Rx L-PDU data to the provided buffer
Notes: Guarded by CANIF_READRXPDU_DATA_API==STD_ON; returns E_NOT_OK (not implemented)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_ReadTxNotifStatus shall return the TX notification status of an L-PDU
Notes: Guarded by CANIF_READTXPDU_NOTIFY_STATUS_API==STD_ON; returns CANIF_NO_NOTIFICATION (not implemented)

Requirement_Description: CanIf_ReadRxNotifStatus shall return the RX notification status of an L-PDU
Notes: Guarded by CANIF_READRXPDU_NOTIFY_STATUS_API==STD_ON; returns CANIF_NO_NOTIFICATION (not implemented)

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall call PduR_CanIfRxIndication for PDUs routed through PDU Router
Notes: Guarded by USE_PDUR; calls PduR_CanIfRxIndication with PduInfoType

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall call CanNm_RxIndication for PDUs belonging to CAN Network Management
Notes: Guarded by USE_CANNM; calls CanNm_RxIndication with PDU ID and SDU pointer; NOTE: TODO tag at L47 indicates PduR_CanIf.h import was deferred

Requirement_Description: CanIf_Arc_Error shall notify upper layer of a CAN driver error event
Notes: ArcCore-specific (not standard AUTOSAR API); calls CanIfErrorNotification

Requirement_Description: Pre-initialization of CAN controller before CanIf_Init completes (ArcCore extension)
Notes: Not in AUTOSAR standard; called internally by CanIf_Init to init each controller before initRun is set

Requirement_Description: Internal helper to map HRH hardware object to CanIf channel ID
Notes: Static helper; reports CANIF_E_PARAM_HRH via DET if HRH not found; returns -1 as sentinel

Requirement_Description: Internal helper to find Tx PDU config entry by PDU ID
Notes: Returns NULL if id >= CanIfNumberOfCanTXPduIds; bounds-check only

Requirement_Description: Internal helper to find Rx PDU config entry by PDU ID (runtime PDU config only)
Notes: Only available when CANIF_ARC_RUNTIME_PDU_CONFIGURATION==STD_ON

Requirement_Description: Get the receive HRH config handler for a given CanIf channel (runtime PDU config only)
Notes: Only available when CANIF_ARC_RUNTIME_PDU_CONFIGURATION==STD_ON

Requirement_Description: Get the transmit HTH config handler for a given CanIf channel (runtime PDU config only)
Notes: Only available when CANIF_ARC_RUNTIME_PDU_CONFIGURATION==STD_ON

Requirement_Description: Return the default configuration index for a given CanIf channel
Notes: Returns Arc_ChannelDefaultConfIndex[Channel] from config

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support transceiver mode setting via CanIf_SetTransceiverMode
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately; transceiver API not implemented

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support transceiver mode reading via CanIf_GetTransceiverMode
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support wakeup reason reading via CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support transceiver wakeup mode setting via CanIf_SetTransceiverWakeupMode
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support wakeup source checking via CanIf_CheckWakeup
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately

Requirement_Description: CanIf shall support wakeup validation via CanIf_CheckValidation
Notes: Returns E_NOT_OK immediately
